'''Dream-walkers''' were a sub-sect of [[Voss Mystics]] outcasts, who practiced the ritual of [[Dream-walking]]. Not entirely embraced by the [[Voss]] society, they had an encampment in the caves beneath [[Voss-Ka]] called the [[Mind healer's grove]].

==History==
Around [[3640 BBY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] approached the dream-walker [[Asa-Ku]], looking for the information on the [[Forbidden Ritual]], known only to them.

==Behind the scenes==
The Dream-walkers appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Voss.
